description: Classify one cookie by name: which vendor pattern it matches, the organisation that receives and uses the data (the legal party), its purpose, typical retention, and control class. Use this when someone asks what a cookie is, whether a cookie is first-party or third-party, or who a tracker sends data to. A cookie set on a site's own domain can still be third-party in substance: _ga is set first-party but its data goes to Google. Unknown names return known: false instead of a guess.

name.description: The cookie name only, for example '_ga' or '_fbp'. Not a value, not a URL.

name: classify_cookie

classification.description: The classification result for the cookie name.

title: Classify a cookie by who receives its data
